### Receipt 2: Vivek OnPoint Creator Platform
- URL: https://vivekonpoint.com
- Repository: https://github.com/AmanSuryavanshi-1/Vivek-OnPoint-Web
- Category: Production Creator Platform (Headless Notion CMS)
- Commercial & Operational Impact:
  - 100% build reliability across all Vercel edge deployments
  - 0 Notion API 429 rate-limit breaches (down from frequent build breakages)
  - 99.9% uptime with static fallback resilience during Notion maintenance windows
  - Zero draft content leaks or compliance violations
- The 11-Layer Notion CMS Defense System:
  1. Semaphore Throttler: Strict client-side queue limiting Notion API calls to 0.67 requests/sec (well below Notion's 3 req/s hard cap).
  2. Jittered Exponential Backoff: Full-jitter exponential retry strategy handling transient 429 and 502 gateway errors.
  3. Emergency Bypass Mode: Version-controlled static fallback snapshots served if Notion API becomes totally unreachable.
  4. Post-Zod Draft Leakage Guard: Runtime schema assertion ensuring unpublished drafts never render in production.
  5. Content-Loss Guard: Validates that parsed pages contain non-empty body blocks before overwriting ISR cache.
  6. Edge Rate Limiting: Powered by @upstash/ratelimit on Upstash Redis to prevent scraping DDoS.
  7. Tracking Param Cache Stripping: Edge middleware that normalizes UTM and social query parameters to avoid CDN cache fragmentation.
  8. SEBI / ASCI Compliance Scanner: Automated regex verification checking for mandated educational disclosures and sponsor tags.
  9. ISR Freshness Probes: Automated health check endpoint (/api/health/isr-freshness) alerting if caches exceed SLA.
  10. Strict Zod Schema Parsing: Discriminated union validation transforming raw Notion block trees into typesafe UI models.
  11. Multi-Database Relational Mapping: Efficiently resolves relations across 8 Notion databases (Sources, Bookshelf, FAQ, Newsletter, Sponsors, Corrections).

### Receipt 3: notebooklm-py (16.5k★) Core Architecture Contribution
- Pull Request: https://github.com/tomaarsen/notebooklm-py/pull/276
- Repository: https://github.com/tomaarsen/notebooklm-py (16.5k+ GitHub Stars)
- Commits: 5c3f325391eef248b94b885972e032212be009ca, 4bacf1c981eb0fc701dd92e105e94b29ceee89ca
- Code Diff: +1,483 lines added, -353 lines refactored across 8 core architecture modules
- Problem Solved:
  - Google NotebookLM's authentication tokens expire every ~10 minutes, redirecting requests (HTTP 302) across domains to accounts.google.com.
  - Standard HTTP libraries (httpx) drop raw request 'Cookie' headers upon cross-domain redirects for security reasons, causing immediate session termination and CLI crashes.
  - Windows default asyncio event loop policy caused fatal transport failures during Playwright cookie extraction.
- Technical Solution:
  - Domain-Preserving Cookie Jar: Implemented build_cookie_jar() binding session cookies explicitly to google.com and notebooklm.google.com domains.
  - DomainCookieMap Type: Structured type-safe cookie management preserving token freshness across redirect hops.
  - Atomic File Persistence: Re-architected save_cookies_to_storage() utilizing tempfile and os.chmod(0o600) with atomic file replacement (os.replace) to eliminate race conditions.
  - Windows Asyncio Loop Patch: Explicitly configured WindowsProactorEventLoopPolicy, ensuring 100% headless token harvesting reliability on Windows OS.

### Receipt 4: OmniPost-Core Multi-Platform Distribution Engine
- Repository: https://github.com/AmanSuryavanshi-1/AmanSuryavanshi.dev/tree/main/Omni-Post-AI-Automation
- Documentation: https://www.amansuryavanshi.me/docs/omnipost/01-executive-summary
- Category: Multi-Agent AI System & Distributed Automation
- Operational Metrics:
  - 122 total n8n workflow nodes across dual-stream architecture
  - 7+ publishing destinations: LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Threads, Sanity, Dev.to, Hashnode, Reddit
  - 80% reduction in end-to-end content production time
  - $0/month operational costs
- Core Subsystems:
  - FastMCP Knowledge Bridge (:3010): Streamable Model Context Protocol server exposing living Markdown notes from Obsidian Second Brain directly to AI agents.
  - FastAPI Research Bridge (:3012): Headless service querying Google NotebookLM knowledge vaults with zero per-token inference charges.
  - 5-Layer Slop Linter: Deterministic regex and AST scanner eliminating 39 AI writing tells, corporate clichés, and markdown formatting defects.
  - Playwright Carousel Compiler: Headless automated rendering engine compiling JSON slides into 300 DPI 2160x2700 PNG image carousels for LinkedIn.
  - Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ): Redis-backed payload retention preserving failed webhook requests for human replay.
